name: Fedelm of Munster

attributes.attribute: listed on page 181 of the index
one of the Fedelm entries in the F section

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The index of the encyclopedia records Fedelm of Munster. The listing points to page 181. The other Fedelm women appear on the same leaf. They are the seer of Cruachan, the princess of Connacht, and the Nine-Times Beautiful. Fedelm of Munster holds its own line among them in the F section.
